$comment: Gold standard for the real 9-minute Plaud round (4 patients, ward handover).
THIS TRANSCRIPT IS HEAVILY ASR-DEGRADED, and that is the point. The grading
rule here is FAITHFULNESS TO WHAT WAS SAID, not to what was clinically meant.
Silently repairing a garbled number or drug name into the plausible clinical
fact is a hallucination — the most dangerous failure this system can have,
because the repaired value looks correct and carries a real quote.
Hence `forbiddenText`: strings that were NEVER spoken and whose appearance
means the model corrected the ASR instead of reporting it. Examples:
- the round says 'לחץ דם ה-28 ל-78'. Faithful extraction gives 28/78, which
the vitals guardrail should flag as out of range. '128' appears nowhere.
the operation actually performed per the mock notes) is never spoken.
NEEDS CLINICAL REVIEW: patients 2 and 4 contain badly garbled vitals
('118 ב-18 על 72 דווקא 76', 'תחץ דם 2274') where even a human cannot say what
was meant. Those are deliberately annotated loosely.
